parameters.name: GuestClusterID
parameters.description: The ID of the Kubernetes cluster that is added to the ASM instance.

parameters.name: ShowNsLabels
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return the labels of the namespaces.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh describe-guest-cluster-namespaces --service-mesh-id ce134b0727aa2492db69f6c3880e0000 --guest-cluster-id c584d805c7bd442b8bac421f9849f0000 --show-ns-labels true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh DescribeGuestClusterNamespaces --region cn-hangzhou --GuestClusterID c584d805c7bd442b8bac421f9849f0000 --ServiceMeshId ce134b0727aa2492db69f6c3880e0000 --ShowNsLabels true
